title: Demo environment — metrics & adoption tracking (working sheet)
content:
Purpose
- Track whether the demo tenant + run-of-show is actually being used in the field, and whether it’s stable enough to be the default.
- Keep this lightweight: one sheet for “demo events” (per demo), one for “weekly rollup”, one for “open issues / failure modes”.

Cadence
- Owners update: weekly (Mon EOD local)
- Readout: Sales/SE sync (Tue)
- Monthly summary: GTM leadership + Eng/SRE (first week of month)

Data sources (current + planned)
- Manual entry (today): SE fills “Demo event log” right after call.
- Automated (planned, in progress): pull from demo healthcheck + reset CLI + console telemetry for:
  - reset duration
  - errors (429s, auth, streaming disconnect)
  - dashboard freshness
  - model pin/fallback events

Definitions (so we don’t fight the numbers)
- “Demo”: any external prospect/customer call where Redwood demo tenant is used live OR backup recording/screenshots used due to failure.
- “Scenario completion”: the scenario was shown end-to-end (not just talked about). Partial completion gets marked in notes.
- “Reset time”: start when SE runs reset command; end when healthcheck is green and dashboards show non-empty (or synthetic traffic job is confirmed running).
- “Demo failure”: any unplanned issue that disrupts the flow and requires (a) switching to backup mode or (b) skipping a planned scenario.
- “Demo regression”: repeated failure for the same reason across 2+ demos OR any failure after a fix was marked done.

SHEET 1 — Demo event log (one row per demo)
Columns (recommended)
| Column | Type | Example | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Date | date | 2026-02-06 | local to demo |
| Region | dropdown | NA / EMEA | if mixed, pick primary |
| Segment | dropdown | Mid-market / Enterprise / Startup | |
| Prospect / account | text | Northstar Payments Co. | OK to include company name (no customer data) |
| AE | text | Avery Johnson | |
| SE | text | Markus Klein | |
| Demo format | dropdown | 30m standard / 20m exec / 45m deep dive | |
| Demo tenant mode | dropdown | live / backup-recording / backup-screenshots | |
| Primary persona | dropdown | App Eng / ML Platform / Security / Procurement | pick “who drove the call” |
| Scenarios planned | multi-select | Core API; Economics; Observability; Reliability; Security | keep to 3–5 |
| Scenarios completed | multi-select | Core API; Economics; Reliability | |
| Scenario completion rate | formula | =COUNT(completed)/COUNT(planned) | convert to % |
| Reset used before demo? | yes/no | Yes | |
| Reset duration (min) | number | 7 | if none, leave blank |
| Healthcheck status pre-demo | dropdown | Green / Yellow / Red / Not run | “Yellow” allowed but note why |
| Issues encountered | multi-select | 429/quota; auth/RBAC; dashboards empty; model unavailable; streaming disconnect; console bug; other | |
| Severity | dropdown | None / Minor / Major | Major = switched to backup / skipped scenario |
| Failure? | yes/no | No | should match severity = Major usually |
| Failure reason (primary) | dropdown | quota; dashboards empty; auth; model pin/fallback confusion; streaming; console; other | only if failure=yes |
| Backup path used | dropdown | none / recording / screenshots / canned outputs | |
| Notes / follow-ups | text | “429 spikes during economics demo; adjust rate-limit preset; follow up w/ Eng SRE” | short but actionable |
| Follow-up ticket link | text | Jira SUP-4127 | ok to paste key/link |

Add rerank snippet to standard run-of-show?” |  |

Need clearer ‘what we can show’ slide.” |  |

SHEET 2 — Weekly rollup (auto from event log; manual if needed)
Key metrics
| Metric | Definition | Target (phase 1) | Owner | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| # demos / week | count of event log rows | trend up | Stephanie Nguyen (NA), Lukas Meyer (EMEA) | indicates adoption |
| % demos using live tenant | live / total | >= 85% | Markus Klein | too low => demo is brittle or people avoid it |
| Scenario completion rate | avg(completed/planned) | >= 80% | Markus Klein | lower means talk track / flow issues OR failures |
| Demo failure rate | failures / total | <= 5% | Sean Gallagher | any spike => investigate top reasons |
| Median reset time (min) | median reset duration | <= 8 min | Devon Price | long resets are a top driver of “avoid live demo” |
| P90 reset time (min) | 90th percentile | <= 15 min | Devon Price | controls worst-case pain |
| Dashboard non-empty rate | % demos where Console graphs are populated at showtime | >= 95% | Allison Grant / Mei Lin | biggest perception killer when empty |
| 429 incidence rate | % demos with quota/rate-limit issue | <= 2% | Sean Gallagher | tie to quota preset |
| Auth/RBAC incident rate | % demos with access issues | 0% | Ethan Park | should be eliminated w/ guardrails |
| Streaming disconnect incidence | % demos with streaming issue | <= 1% | Monica Patel (SDK) / Eng | region-specific issues track separately |
| # open demo-blocking bugs | count of “Major” issues not resolved | 0–2 | Talia Benson | keep the list short + focused |

Weekly rollup table (fill each Monday)
| Week starting | # demos | % live | Avg scenario completion | Failure rate | Median reset (min) | P90 reset (min) | Top 1 failure reason | Notes | Owner |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|---|---|
| 2026-01-06 | 6 | 83% | 0.78 | 8% | 7 | 18 | dashboards empty | “2 demos had empty graphs until synthetic traffic job ran. Need stronger pre-demo checklist + auto-start job.” | Allison Grant |
| 2026-02-03 | 5 | 80% | 0.74 | 10% | 9 | 22 | quota/rate limit | “Burst step in tool-calling scenario triggers 429 in NA. Adjust preset + update run-of-show concurrency guidance.” | Sean Gallagher |

SHEET 3 — Failure modes + actions (keep to the ‘top 10’)
| Failure mode | Symptoms in demo | Immediate workaround | Root cause guess | Owner | Tracking link | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Dashboards empty | graphs show “no data” | run synthetic traffic generator; switch to screenshots | traffic job not running OR time range default | Allison Grant | Jira SUP-4189 / Linear ENG-4833 | in progress |
| 429 throttling | tool-calling step fails; retries spike | reduce concurrency; switch to canned output | quota preset too low for parallel demos | Sean Gallagher | Jira SUP-4127 / Linear ENG-4894 | planned |
| RBAC misconfig | SE can’t access org/project | request role remap; use backup | SSO role mapping / manual role drift | Ethan Park | Jira INT-993 / Linear ENG-4855 | in progress |
| Streaming disconnect (EU) | stream stops mid-response | retry with non-streaming; switch to recording | region edge bug | Monica Patel | Jira SUP-4302 | investigating |

Reporting owners / responsibilities (explicit)
- Talia Benson: owns the sheet + weekly readout notes + chasing missing event logs.
- Markus Klein: owns “field adoption” + scenario completion + demo hygiene changes to the run-of-show.
- Sean Gallagher: owns reliability metrics + thresholds + escalation when failure rate spikes.
- Allison Grant: owns dashboard freshness + console demo readiness.
- Devon Price: owns reset automation + reset timing metrics.

Open questions / TODO (keep short)
- Should we require a ‘healthcheck green’ screenshot/link attached to every demo event log? (Pros: accountability; Cons: annoying.)
- Standardize a unique “demo_id” that the reset CLI, synthetic traffic job, and event log can share.
- Decide if we split metrics by “standard 30m” vs “exec 20m” (exec demos have less room for recovery).

Notes to whoever edits next
- Please don’t add customer data beyond company name + high-level segment; keep everything demo/synthetic.
- If a demo uses screenshots/recording by choice (not due to failure), mark mode=backup but severity=None and explain in notes (we need to distinguish preference vs brittleness).
